acceptance_predicates.description: A clean room completes default-dev install, wizard selection, benchmark, recording, offline replay, comparison, rollback, and removal.
Provider, authentication method, agents, models, workloads, and shared defaults are selection-driven and recorded, including OpenRouter, opencode, and opendesk fixtures.
Replay denies network access and consumes only the recorded cassette for selected and all-workload captures.
Human and JSON receipts bind exact ASB/TUI heads, source/build identity, selection, network boundary, cleanup, and PTY evidence.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management are visible warnings and never blockers.

definition_of_done: Exact paired heads pass the full journey with human and JSON receipts.
Independent review accepts cleanup, rollback/removal, and network-denial evidence.
PR253 is treated as a candidate implementation dependency until merged and rerun at merged heads.

inputs.description: Exact ASB/TUI heads and disposable workspace.
asb-tui PR253, used only as candidate evidence until merged.

gates.description: The full setup-to-analysis journey passes without hidden authentication prerequisites.
